text:
maria: @channel quick sync — running a focused post-webinar email sequence + newsletter slice to drive early-access signups for the benchmark report. want to finalize segments + subject lines by EOD. :wave:

liam: ok — what segments are we thinking? company size, signal (api usage), webinar attendance?

alex_p: my rec: three priority buckets: 1) webinar attendees, 2) leads with >10 calls/day (product-fit signal), 3) cold trial accounts (inactive). smaller N groups get personal outreach.

tara: +1. also add a holdback group (5%) for the nurture sends to measure baseline conversion. can we do a 3x subject test for bucket 1?

maria: yep. holdback: 5% per segment, and a canary send to 250 high-intent leads first. timeline: canary today afternoon, full send tomorrow 10am PT, follow-up drip over 7 days.

liam: subject line ideas (draft):
```
Attendee subject A: Thanks for joining — your benchmark preview inside
Attendee subject B: Benchmark highlights from our webinar — see your snapshot
Attendee subject C: Missed this? Key benchmark takeaways + early access
```

alex_p: for product-fit (heavy API users) try more technical subject: "How your token spend compares — quick benchmark"

tara: CTA split: half get "Download full benchmark" (PDF gated), half get "Request a demo" (sales routed). we need UTM params for both.

maria: routing rules: demo CTAs go to SDR queue B if company size >50, otherwise SDR queue A. growth-bot will create the split lists and update the campaign. @growth-bot can you confirm?

growth-bot: action queued — creating segments: attendees (n=1,420), heavy-api (n=890), cold-trial (n=2,300). applying 5% holdback per segment. generating two campaign variants with UTM params. ETA 12m.

liam: quick checklist for assets: 1) landing page with gated PDF + form (design final?) 2) demo calendar link + prefilled metadata 3) 3 subject line variants uploaded to SendGrid 4) segment CSV export for SDRs

maria: design landed this morning — link: https://drive.redwood/designs/benchmark-landing-v3 (ask tara for creds). copy tweaks: shorten preview line for mobile.

alex_p: sample SendGrid campaign config snippet (we'll paste into the UI):
```
from_name: Redwood Inference
from_email: hello@redwood.com
reply_to: growth@redwood.com
utm_source: newsletter
utm_campaign: benchmark_q2_2026
```

tara: A/B measurement: primary metric = early-access downloads (day 3), secondary = demo requests (day 7). report in GA + intercom events. can ops add a dashboard?

maria: @liam can you own the dashboard? i’ll coordinate copy + subject tests. alex — can you confirm SDR routing config after growth-bot finishes segments?

liam: i’ll build a quick Looker dashboard for downloads + demo CTR, Qs on dimension: add segment and subject variant.

alex_p: confirmed — will validate SDR routing and ensure CRM campaign tags are applied.

maria: perfect. final timing: canary 3:30pm PT today, full send 10:00am PT tomorrow. please flag any blockers now. :rocket:

liam: no blockers from my side.

alex_p: blocking: need final landing GIF size under 1MB. tara — can you compress?

tara: on it, will push optimized GIF in 20m.

maria: thanks all — let's reconvene after the canary results and pick winners for the full send.

growth-bot: canary sent to 250 attendees at 1755554321.443. will post engagement metrics in 30m.
